## Public release classification

| Source family | Provenance | Public status | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| WeMD retained Web, Electron, and core source | Pinned upstream commit `964525d80ef63477c3a4b0327fe2a43415ee2bad`; root MIT license | `INCLUDE_WITH_ATTRIBUTION` | Fork base; preserve WeMD Team copyright and MIT text |
| Inherited `apps/server` | Same upstream pin; component manifest declared `UNLICENSED` | `EXCLUDE` | Root/component metadata conflict is not resolved by changing the fork manifest |
| MPForge packages, Mock service, CLI, MCP, tests, scripts, and `.agents/skills` | MPForge commits after the fork baseline; MIT workspace manifests | `INCLUDE` | Original modifications; record in `NOTICE.md` |
| Original MPForge themes under `packages/themes` | MPForge commits and local theme metadata | `INCLUDE` | Do not confuse with inherited themes under `packages/core/src/themes` |
| WeMD application and PWA icons | Inherited at the upstream pin | `INCLUDE_AS_FORK_ASSET_OR_REPLACE` | Attribute to WeMD; no Tencent or WeChat affiliation claim |
| Personal payment QR images | Inherited upstream documentation assets | `EXCLUDE` | Personal financial identifiers are outside the public boundary |
| Server upload photographs | Inherited server samples | `EXCLUDE` | Copyright and subject authorization are unverified |
| Local Git bundle, toolchains, caches, browser binaries, and downloaded archives | Exact local hashes remain in the local-only download manifest | `LOCAL_ONLY` | Publish metadata, not the downloaded objects |

The sanitized public download record is `downloads/MANIFEST.public.json`. It contains no local absolute path and does not authorize distribution of any entry marked `distributed: false`.
